messages:
sam: Heads-up — eu-west1 preemptible reclaiming hard, our preemptible GPU pool dropped from ~120 -> ~50 nodes in 5m. Hosting /v1/generate p95 latency jumped to ~600ms.

nina: Seeing queues backpressureing on the scheduler, also embed pipeline latency spiking.

infra-bot: Alert: preemptible_node_reclaim_rate HIGH in eu-west1; affected pools: gpu-preemptibles-1; metric_window=5m; timestamp=1792345678

kevin: Can we fail traffic to dedicated eu-west1-dedicated? How much headroom do we have?

maya: Dedicated at ~70% GPU utilization, no warm spare nodes. We can provision on-demand A100s in eu-west1 but startup is ~4-6m.

sam: Short-term playbook: (1) shift low-priority traffic to other regions (us-west1) (2) enable immediate on-demand fallback for critical routes (3) pause non-urgent batch jobs.

nina: I can flip a weight shift for routing — recommend 30% to us-west1 first. @kevin can you enable the fallback route?

kevin: K. Applying weighted routing change now: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routing -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"eu-west1":70,"us-west1":30}}'` -> 202 accepted, change propagating.

maya: Pausing dedupe/async batch workers that hold GPUs. Paused job queue: batch-dedupe-1.

oncall-sre: Customer reports for eu showed 500s on embedding endpoints. Switching those to dedicated fallback as well.

infra-bot: Job queued: create on-demand-a100-pool-eu-west1 (job id: 9a3f). Estimated time to attach: ~5m.

sam: Note on cost — on-demand fallback will add incremental $/hr. We'll keep it until reclaim stabilizes and then tear down. Opening a ticket for cost tracking.

nina: After routing shift reclaim rate slowed, preemptible pool back up to ~65 nodes, latency p95 dropped to ~220ms.

kevin: On-demand pool created and attached, autoscaler configured to prefer dedicated/on-demand then preemptible. Fallback rules in place for critical routes.

maya: Batch paused successfully. Will requeue when preemptible pool healthy.

sam: Action items: nina keep routing change until further notice; kevin leave on-demand fallback on for 15m; maya monitor and requeue batches when safe. I'll spin up an incident note.

nina: ack :thumbsup: 

oncall-sre: Logging incident in #incidents with preliminary severity S2 and link to this thread.

sam: Thanks all — will post postmortem and cost impact once we have stabilization metrics. Closing thread for now.
